Why do residential properties offer a mere 2–3% rental yield while commercial real estate can fetch double that?
In this video, we break down the real economics of real estate investing and answer whether property can truly generate hassle-free passive income. We explore borrowing costs, tax differences, market equilibrium, and the hidden operational risks of commercial properties like tenant churn and high maintenance. Learn how to navigate these dynamics and avoid temporary yield traps to make smarter investment decisions.
